articles.summary: GRBK GHO Homes, LLC d/b/a GHO Homes, a subsidiary of Green Brick Partners, Inc. (NYSE: GRBK), has earned the Builder of the Year award for the sixth consecutive year from the Treasure Coast Community Choice Awards. The Treasure Coast Community Choice Award celebrates local businesses and organizations that have made an impact on the region. Driven entirely by public nominations and votes, the recognition reflects the enduring trust that Treasure Coast residents place in GHO Homes, a homebuilder with more than four decades of building communities in the Treasure Coast area. Bill Handler, President of GHO Homes, said, "This honor speaks volumes about the dedication of our team and the trust our homeowners place in us. We are humbled by the continuing support from the community and look forward to building even more homes that enhance lives and neighborhoods. articles.title: GHO Homes Continues Streak with Sixth Consecutive Builder of the Year Award
